title: Monomial positivity conjecture for H-graph ideals
statement: Let $P$ be a $(\mathbf{3}+\mathbf{1})$-free poset, let $I_H^P$ be the corresponding $H$-graph ideal, and let $\mathfrak{m}^P_\lambda(\mathbf{u})$ be the elements defined in the source. Say that an element is **$\mathbf{u}$-monomial positive modulo $I_H^P$** if it has a representative that is a positive sum of monomials in the noncommuting variables $\mathbf{u}$. **Monomial positivity conjecture.** For every such $P$ and partition $\lambda$, $\mathfrak{m}^P_\lambda(\mathbf{u})$ is $\mathbf{u}$-monomial positive modulo $I_H^P$; consequently, for every $I_H^P$-graph $\Gamma$, $\omega F_\Gamma(\mathbf{x})$ is $e$-positive. The supplied text gives no resolution status.
source_name: Jonah Blasiak, Holden Eriksson, Pavlo Pylyavskyy and Isaiah Siegl, “Noncommutative Schur functions for posets”, arXiv:2211.03967 (2022).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.03967

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of November 2022). “This conjecture was proven several years later by Brosnan and Chow and independently by Guay-Paquet .”
